method: One in-process Jev call per prompt with the prompt hook's questions (every live line, bare-id choice, one relevance noul per line, replaces context), cache off; the rule scored offline: a line is picked when relevance ≥ 0.8 and (relevance ≥ sure or choice ≥ min), top 5 by relevance. Lines with relevance under 0.5 and choice under 0.01 are left out of `answers` (no rule here can pick them).
